'''Nalydians''' were a a [[Species/Legends|species]] of small brown-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nalyd]]. By [[138 ABY]], they had developed a civilization among the stony pinnacles and mesas of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], which was covered in a swirling orange fog. They also succeeded in taming a [[Nalydian giant spider|spider-like species]]. They were known to have public executions in public arenas for various crimes including murder, assault, and the sabotage of public transport. One known Nalydian was the criminal [[Dieben]], who was extradited back to Nalyd following the [[Carreras Incident]] to face execution for various felonies.
